verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a locally run video-generation app with a web UI and npm CLI scripts, so a published machine-readable API spec is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack never mentions an OpenAPI spec, a schema, or any documented HTTP API. The CLI commands (npm run doctor, post-video) and the Markdown style files are not an API spec, and the .md docs probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
